request.prompt:
Extract the following fields from the product description and reply with a single
JSON object and nothing else.

Fields:
- "name": the product name as written (string)
- "price": the numeric price without currency symbols or thousands separators (number, or null if no price is given)
- "currency": three-letter ISO code such as USD, EUR, GBP, JPY (string, or null if no price is given)
- "in_stock": true if the text says the item is available now, false if it says it is out of stock, backordered, or discontinued (boolean)

Description:
Pico USB-C hub (7 ports) now only $19.95, was $34.95. Ready to ship.

response.text:
Here is the extracted JSON:
```json
{"name": "Pico USB-C hub", "price": 19.95, "currency": "USD", "in_stock": true}
```
